name: Defense Nucleus
pickupText: Summon an Alpha Construct on killing an elite.
description: Killing elite monsters spawns an Alpha Construct with bonus 300% damage and 300% health. Limited to 4 (+4 per stack).

name: Functional Coupler
pickupText: Holds an additional equipment.
description: Hold 1 additional equipment (+1 per stack). Press the interact and equipment buttons to cycle through held equipment.

name: Faulty Conductor
pickupText: Occasionally release a pulse of electricity that energizes allies and makes enemies more susceptible to electric damage.
description: Every 15 (-20% per stack) seconds, release a wave of electricity that energizes nearby allies for 7 seconds. Energized allies gain +30% attack and movement speed and always land critical strikes with electric items and attacks.

stacking.formula: interval multiplied by 0.8 per stack (multiplicative, so it shortens but never hits zero)

name: Sentry Key
pickupText: Gain +15% move speed. Can be placed in a Sentry Terminal.
description: Gain +15% move speed. Can be placed in a Sentry Terminal or used for decryption.

name: Prison Matrix
pickupText: Gain +50% armor. Can be placed in a Matrix Terminal.
description: Gain +50% armor. Can be placed in a Matrix Terminal.

name: Encrypted Cerebellum
pickupText: Contains encrypted remnants of the Collective network. Needs to be decrypted.
description: A quest item with no direct effect. Decrypt it (via the Wandering CHEF) to create the Exposed Cerebellum used to reach the Neural Sanctum.

name: Exposed Cerebellum
pickupText: A swarming data nexus representing the Collective network. Can be given to a powerful entity.
description: A quest item with no effect on the player; given to SPEX in the Computational Exchange.

name: Item Scrap, Yellow
pickupText: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with 3D Printers.
description: A Boss-rarity scrap with no effect. Consumed first by 3D Printers and Cauldrons, letting you preserve real items.

name: Shaped Glass
pickupText: Double your damage... BUT halve your health.
description: Increase base damage by 100% (+100% per stack). Reduce maximum health by 50% (+50% per stack).

stacking.formula: base damage multiplied by 2 per stack (×2, ×4, ×8, …)
maximum health multiplied by 0.5 per stack (half, quarter, …)

name: Brittle Crown
pickupText: Gain gold on hit... BUT surrender gold on getting hit.
description: 30% chance on hit to gain 2 (+2 per stack) gold. Lose gold on taking damage equal to 100% (+100% per stack) of the maximum health percentage lost.

name: Transcendence
pickupText: Convert all your health into shield. Increase maximum health.
description: Convert all but 1 health into regenerating shields. Gain 50% (+25% per stack) maximum health.

name: Corpsebloom
pickupText: Double your healing... BUT it's applied over time.
description: Heal +100% (+100% per stack) more. All healing is applied over time, capped at a maximum of 10% (-50% per stack) of your health per second.

stacking.stat: Max heal per second (% of health)
stacking.formula: heal-per-second cap divides reciprocally: 10% at 1 stack, ~6.7% at 2, 5% at 3, …

name: Gesture of the Drowned
pickupText: Dramatically reduce Equipment cooldown... BUT it automatically activates.
description: Reduce Equipment cooldown by 50% (+15% per stack). Forces your Equipment to activate whenever it is off cooldown.

stacking.formula: cooldown = base x 0.5 x 0.85^(stacks-1) (multiplicative)

name: Purity
pickupText: Reduce your skill cooldowns by 2 seconds. You are unlucky.
description: All skill cooldowns are reduced by 2 (+1 per stack) seconds. All random effects are rolled +1 (+1 per stack) times for an unfavorable outcome.

name: Visions of Heresy
pickupText: Replace your Primary Skill with 'Hungering Gaze'.
description: Fire a flurry of tracking shards that detonate after a delay for 120% base damage. Hold up to 12 charges (+12 per stack) that reload after 2 seconds (+2 per stack).

name: Strides of Heresy
pickupText: Replace your Utility Skill with 'Shadowfade'.
description: Fade away, becoming intangible and gaining +30% movement speed. Heal for 18.2% (+18.2% per stack) of your maximum health. Lasts 3 (+3 per stack) seconds.

name: Hooks of Heresy
pickupText: Replace your Secondary Skill with 'Slicing Maelstrom'.
description: Charge a projectile dealing 875% damage per second to nearby enemies, exploding after 3 seconds for 700% damage and rooting enemies for 3 (+3 per stack) seconds. Recharges after 5 (+5 per stack) seconds.

name: Essence of Heresy
pickupText: Replace your Special Skill with 'Ruin'.
description: Dealing damage adds a stack of Ruin for 10 (+10 per stack) seconds. Activating the skill detonates all Ruin stacks at unlimited range for 300% damage plus 120% per stack of Ruin. Recharges after 8 (+8 per stack) seconds.

name: Beads of Fealty
pickupText: Seems to do nothing... but...
description: Has no direct effect. Obliterating yourself at the Obelisk in A Moment, Fractured instead transports you to A Moment, Whole — a hidden realm containing a Twisted Scavenger.

name: Focused Convergence
pickupText: Increase the speed of Teleporter charging... BUT reduce the size of the zone.
description: Teleporters charge 30% (+30% per stack) faster, but the size of the Teleporter zone is 50% (-50% per stack) smaller.

stacking.formula: zone shrinks reciprocally per stack (50% at 1 stack, then diminishing)

name: Defiant Gouge
pickupText: Using a Shrine summons enemies nearby.
description: Using a Shrine summons enemies nearby, stronger per stack (+40% per stack). Scales over time.

name: Mercurial Rachis
pickupText: Randomly create a Ward of Power. ALL characters deal bonus damage while in the Ward.
description: Creates a Ward of Power in a random nearby location, 16m (+50% per stack) in radius, that causes both enemies and allies inside to deal +50% damage.

stacking.formula: radius increased 50% per stack (multiplicative)

name: Stone Flux Pauldron
pickupText: Double your health... BUT halve your speed.
description: Increase max health by 100% (+100% per stack). Reduce movement speed by 50% (+50% per stack).

stacking.formula: speed penalty stacks reciprocally, approaching but never reaching a full stop

name: Light Flux Pauldron
pickupText: Halve your cooldowns... BUT halve your attack speed.
description: Decrease skill cooldowns by 50% (+50% per stack). Decrease attack speed by 50% (+50% per stack).

stacking.formula: cooldown multiplied by 0.5 per stack (multiplicative)
attack speed penalty stacks reciprocally, approaching but never reaching zero

name: Longstanding Solitude
pickupText: Free purchases on level up... BUT gold converts to experience.
description: On level up, gain a free unlock for the next purchase (+1 per stack), but all gold is converted to experience. Anything that costs gold costs 50% (+50% per stack) more.

name: Egocentrism
pickupText: Gain multiple orbiting bombs. Every minute, assimilate another item into Egocentrism.
description: Every 3 (-50% per stack) seconds, gain an orbiting bomb that detonates on impact for 360% damage, up to a maximum of 3 bombs (+1 per stack). Every 60 seconds, a random item is converted into this item.

stacking.formula: spawn interval divides reciprocally per stack (3s, ~2s, 1.5s, …)

name: Neutronium Weight
pickupText: Reduces your stats while in combat, but send this item to an enemy on hit.
description: Reduces damage by 30% (+10% per stack), attack speed by 30% (+10% per stack), movement speed by 30% (+10% per stack), and armor by 35 (+15 per stack).

stacking.formula: each stat penalty stacks multiplicatively (-10% per stack)

name: Eulogy Zero
pickupText: Items and equipment have a small chance to transform into a Lunar item instead.
description: Items have a 5% (+5% per stack) chance to become a Lunar item instead.

stacking.stat: Chance to become a Lunar item (%)

name: Needletick
pickupText: Chance to collapse enemies on hit. Corrupts all Tri-Tip Daggers.
description: 10% (+10% per stack) chance to collapse an enemy for 400% base damage. Corrupts all Tri-Tip Daggers.

name: Lost Seer's Lenses
pickupText: Gain a chance to instantly kill a non-boss enemy. Corrupts all Lens-Maker's Glasses.
description: Your attacks have a 0.5% (+0.5% per stack) chance to instantly kill a non-Boss enemy. Corrupts all Lens-Maker's Glasses.

name: Safer Spaces
pickupText: Block the next source of damage. Corrupts all Tougher Times.
description: Blocks incoming damage once. Recharges after 13.5 seconds (-10% per stack). Corrupts all Tougher Times.

stacking.formula: recharge multiplied by 0.9 per stack (multiplicative)

name: Weeping Fungus
pickupText: Heal while sprinting. Corrupts all Bustling Fungi.
description: Heals for 2% (+2% per stack) of your health every second while sprinting. Corrupts all Bustling Fungi.

stacking.stat: Heal per second while sprinting (% health)

name: Encrusted Key
pickupText: Gain access to an Encrusted Cache that contains a void item. Corrupts all Rusted Keys.
description: A hidden cache containing a void item will appear in a random location on each stage. Opening the cache consumes this item. Corrupts all Rusted Keys.

stacking.formula: one cache per stage per key-holder; additional keys raise the cache item's rarity

name: Plasma Shrimp
pickupText: While you have shield, fire missiles on every hit. Corrupts all AtG Missile Mk. 1s.
description: Gain a shield equal to 10% of your maximum health. While you have a shield, hitting an enemy fires a missile that deals 40% (+40% per stack) TOTAL damage. Corrupts all AtG Missile Mk. 1s.

name: Lysate Cell
pickupText: Add an extra charge of your Special skill. Corrupts all Fuel Cells.
description: Add +1 (+1 per stack) charge of your Special skill. Reduces Special skill cooldown by 33%. Corrupts all Fuel Cells.

name: Polylute
pickupText: Chance on hit to fire chain lightning. Corrupts all Ukuleles.
description: 25% chance to fire lightning for 60% TOTAL damage up to 3 (+3 per stack) times. Corrupts all Ukuleles.

name: Tentabauble
pickupText: Chance to root enemies on hit. Corrupts all Chronobaubles.
description: 5% (+5% per stack) chance on hit to root enemies for 1s (+1s per stack). Corrupts all Chronobaubles.

stacking.formula: proc chance stacks hyperbolically, approaching but never reaching 100%

name: Singularity Band
pickupText: High damage hits also create unstable black holes. Corrupts all Runald's and Kjaro's Bands.
description: Hits that deal more than 400% damage fire a black hole that draws enemies within 15m into its center, lasting 5 seconds before collapsing for 100% (+100% per stack) TOTAL damage. Recharges every 20 seconds. Corrupts all Runald's and Kjaro's Bands.

name: Voidsent Flame
pickupText: Full health enemies also detonate on hit. Corrupts all Will-o'-the-wisps.
description: Upon hitting an enemy at full health, spawn a lava pillar in a 12m (+2.4m per stack) radius for 260% (+156% per stack) base damage. Corrupts all Will-o'-the-wisps.

name: Benthic Bloom
pickupText: Upgrades your items at the start of each stage. Corrupts all 57 Leaf Clovers.
description: Upgrades 3 (+3 per stack) random items to items of the next higher rarity at the start of each stage. Corrupts all 57 Leaf Clovers.

name: Pluripotent Larva
pickupText: Get a corrupted extra life. Consumed on use. Corrupts all Dio's Best Friends.
description: Upon death, this item is consumed and you return to life with 3 seconds of invulnerability, and all of your items that can be corrupted will be. Corrupts all Dio's Best Friends.

name: Newly Hatched Zoea
pickupText: Periodically recruit allies from the Void. Corrupts all yellow items.
description: Every 60 (-50% per stack) seconds, gain a random Void ally, up to a maximum of 1 (+1 per stack) at a time. Corrupts all yellow (boss) items.

stacking.formula: interval divides reciprocally per stack (60s, ~40s, 30s, …)
